questions.text: In the estimate C ≈ 6ND, what do N and D represent?

options.A: Attention head count and hidden dimension.
options.B: Prompt token count and generated token count.
options.D: Model parameter count and training token count.

questions.explanation: The approximate dense-transformer training compute estimate multiplies parameter count N by training token count D and a factor of about6.

questions.text: You double a dense model’s parameter count while keeping its training compute budget fixed under C ≈ 6ND. What happens to the affordable training-token count?
questions.explanation: At fixed C, D=C/(6N); doubling N halves D.
